metadata.title: Sanmina’s Key Driver Is Its Manufacturing Business. It Could Be AI Tomorrow.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
While Sanmina’s Key Driver Is Its Manufacturing Business, It Could Be AI Tomorrow.
Sanmina, like many other electronics manufacturing services providers building hardware, has capitalized on the artificial-intelligence boom. Its latest quarterly earnings, however, reveal it hasn’t been relying exclusively on that surge in revenue.
